svg.title: Render Workflows: each model request and tool call as its own task run
svg.desc: Your application starts the support task with start_task and gets a run ID back at once. On Render, the root task run calls agent.run. RenderWorkflows sends each model request to a chained support__model.request task run and each tool call to a chained call_tool task run, each in its own instance with its own retries, timeout and compute plan. The application reads the result later with get_task_run. Nothing is checkpointed, so a retried root task run repeats finished calls.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
